name: God
overview: Scripture reveals God as the sovereign Creator who brought the universe into existence by His powerful word, as seen in the opening verses of Genesis where God creates the heavens and the earth, commands light into being, and separates it from darkness. These passages emphasize God's authority over creation and His purposeful design, highlighting His active involvement in ordering the world. The Spirit of God is also present, moving over the waters, indicating God's dynamic presence in the formation of all things.
